theme: An open Halloween, with Toronto on the horizon.
greeting: A rare wide-open Saturday, Dan — Halloween with the girls and nothing on the calendar pulling at you. The one thing worth a glance is next week: you're moderating in Toronto on Wednesday.

needsAttention.title: Your Toronto panel is next week
needsAttention.detail: You're moderating Plenary 7 at ICGN's Autumn Conference in Toronto on Nov 4–5. You're still waiting on Rachit at Diligent for final questions before the run of show locks — a nudge this weekend, plus sorting travel from Florida, keeps it from going down to the wire.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board since mid-September. A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out — it's the only six-seater for the girls' Maine trip, so a refundable hold now removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: December trip past its book-by date
needsAttention.detail: The shortlist-three-destinations task is now past its Oct 15 book-by. Six people over three holiday weeks is the thinnest inventory of the year; picking domestic-vs-international and locking a direction is the thing holding everything else up.

flagged.title: KLA — VP, Global Government Affairs
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert for a VP, Global Government Affairs & Strategic Policy role that lines up closely with your public-affairs background.

flagged.title: New Experian credit-file alert
flagged.detail: Experian flagged new activity on your credit file — worth a quick look to confirm it's expected.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters, retail promos, and automated job-board blasts — nothing that needs you.

resolved.title: Toronto panel outline signed off
resolved.detail: Jane (BNP Paribas) and Andy (Schroders) both approved your run of show this week, and ICGN has registered your comp place — the panel itself is set.

tasks.title: Portland house order — king bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: Not a single meeting today — the first fully open Saturday in a while is yours to spend slowly.
The afternoon stays clear, a good window if you want to get a jump on next week before travel.
Halloween with the girls tonight, then an easy lead-in to tomorrow's short Sunday review with Mike at 9.
